decisions.evidence: Overall, the combination of phenothiazine chemistry, high basicity, high lipophilicity, low TPSA, and a piperidine-containing cationic amphiphile profile makes inhibition of SARS-CoV-2 replication more likely, even though the partial-charge descriptors are not strongly favorable on their own.
The overall nearest-neighbor evidence therefore supports option (B): inhibits SARS-CoV-2 replication.
